name: Gleaning Our Future
objectiveText: Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar . Heart of Ados  ( 1 ) Heart of Modr  ( 1 ) Heart of Golm  ( 1 ) Heart of Neru  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Very straightforward quest. Use the [b]Goaz Stone[/b] on the golems to wake them up, then kill and loot them. Reaching most golems is very easy, but [b]Ados[/b] is somewhat surrounded by elite orcs. My group was able to reach him without any extra clearing using [spell=453], but we did end up pulling one anyway despite being careful. I recommend you just [b]clear a path to him[/b], because then you'll also have a clear exit route as well.

[b]Modr[/b] only deals [b]Physical[/b] damage. He [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=8269/enrage][b]enrages[/b][/url].
[b]Neru[/b] uses [b]Frost[/b] damage. I believe you can [b]dispel/purge his Frost Armor[/b]. 
[b]Ados[/b] deals [b]Fire[/b] damage. He also absorbs it using [spell=15041], which [b]can[/b] be dispelled.
[b]Golm[/b] does [b]Fire[/b] damage as well, but he mainly [b]does AOE damage[/b]. [spell=16635], [spell=18968] and [spell=11988].

If I recall correctly, each golem had [b]6.8k[/b] health, so a bit tougher than your run-of-the-mill elite, but not like a dungeon boss of equal level. Can be finished with just a healer friend if you can't find anyone else.

Solo'd all of them as a feral druid, decent gear but nothing you couldn't have at launch, maybe 1-2 LW pieces. 
Stick to bear, keep up demo roar, use Bash or Nature's Grasp to pop out and heal.
[b]Modr will enrage at 30% or so[/b], which lasts 2 minutes. Keep him rooted and stay away until it wears off, he did not recast it.
Ados looks like it is alone, but a second after pull I added a [b]stealthed elite orc rogue[/b]. Reset and fight him alone.
